subject: How to remove selections from list with selectize?

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: How to remove selections from list with selectize?
parts:
Hi,
  Must be missing a trick here
With the old-stylee selectInput set for multiple choices, additions were made by ctrl click in Windows. 
Starting a new set of selections was easily done by clicking on an option without holding control down

Now there is no need to hold control button down to add new selections but no obvious way to reset
or remove selections

cheers
andrew clark

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: How to remove selections from list with selectize?
parts:
Hit Backspace or Delete. Or you can enable the "remove_button" plugin
(options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))).

Regards,
Yihui
